name: incontrol-inspect
description: Find forms, create and update drafts, and retrieve completed documents in Incontrol.

interface.longDescription:
Work with digital forms for inspections, audits, and checklists in Incontrol.INSPECT directly from ChatGPT.

Key features:
- Find forms: browse the forms you own or that your organization makes available, and see which fields can be pre-filled.
- Create and update drafts: start a new draft from a form, pre-fill field values and images, and keep track of the status of your drafts.
- Retrieve documents: search your completed documents, read their content and revision history, and download PDFs, attached files, and images.
- Link back to Incontrol: every result can be opened directly in the Incontrol web app.

Requires an Incontrol account. ChatGPT acts as the signed-in user, so access follows your existing permissions and organization.
defaultPrompt: Show me my forms and which fields the first one lets me fill in.
Create a draft from my first form, name it 'Site visit', and fill in today's date.
Get the PDF of my most recent document.

positive.prompt: Show the five most recent documents I can access in Incontrol.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to five of the user's finished documents, newest first, each with its name.

positive.prompt: Show me a form in Incontrol and which fields I can fill in when creating a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Names one of the user's forms and lists the fields a draft can be pre-filled with.

positive.prompt: Create a new empty draft from the first form I own and name it 'Review test draft'.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft named 'Review test draft' from a form the user owns and returns its details.

positive.prompt: Show the status of my draft named 'Review test draft'.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the draft by name and reports its status.

positive.prompt: Get the current PDF for my most recent document in Incontrol.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the PDF of the user's most recent finished document.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Amsterdam today?
